ai_briefing.headline: Critical GitLab vulnerability and AI agent attacks dominate threat landscape
ai_briefing.narrative: A critical GitLab vulnerability is actively exploited, alongside other high-severity issues requiring immediate attention. Threat actors are increasingly leveraging AI agents, as seen in the RubyGems campaign and Claude-based attacks, to automate intrusions and data theft. Additionally, new WordPress RCEs and a phishing campaign abusing mshta.exe pose further risks.
takeaways: Prioritize patching for GitLab CE/EE, especially CVE-2026-85706, which is actively exploited.
Immediately update WordPress installations and plugins, including The Events Calendar and GEO my WP, to mitigate RCE and LFI risks.
Increase monitoring for AI agent-driven activity within your environment and supply chain, given recent attack trends.
Strengthen endpoint detection and email security to counter phishing campaigns abusing legitimate Windows utilities like mshta.exe.
watch_items: Monitor for new attack patterns emerging from AI agent-driven cyberattacks.
Observe potential for wider exploitation of recently disclosed critical vulnerabilities.
